problem:

$$
{y}^{′}=(\operatorname{sec}⁡x)^{\operatorname{tan}⁡x}\cdot g(x).
$$

Find the function $g(x).$

Question 2
?

Consider the function y=(sec⁡x)tan⁡x. Its derivative is given by

y′=(sec⁡x)tan⁡x⋅g(x).

Find the function g(x).

a
sec⁡xln⁡(sec⁡x)+tan⁡x
b
sec2⁡xln⁡(tan⁡x)+cot2⁡x
c
tan2⁡xln⁡(sec⁡x)+tan⁡x
d
sec2⁡xln⁡(sec⁡x)+x
e
sec2⁡xln⁡(sec⁡x)+tan2⁡x
